description: Use this when you need current natural-hazard alerts coarsened to country or NAVAREA region: GDACS, NOAA tsunami, NGA maritime warnings and USGS earthquakes. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: GDACS, Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System, EC-JRC / UN OCHA (https://www.gdacs.org/). GDACS alerts are automatic estimates. Not for life-safety use; follow official national authorities. NOAA / NWS Tsunami Warning Centers (https://www.tsunami.gov/). NGA Maritime Safety Information (https://msi.nga.mil/). Not for navigation. U.S. Geological Survey (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/); credit requested.

region.description: Case-insensitive substring on NAVAREA / tsunami center / country name, e.g. NAVAREA IV.
